display_title: Seductive Curves: The Waxing Shop Managers
description:
Jinchul Choi hesitates when his friend, the waxing shop owner, asks him to be a model for staff training. Tempted by the generous pay, he agrees to participate. However, when he discovers that all the trainees are women, he can't help but get aroused during the waxing session…
